terrainEditor.saveSuccess: Saved to the local working copy
terrainEditor.exportYamlNotFound: No terrain_maps.yaml found at the export destination, so it was not updated
terrainEditor.editHint: Left-click to apply the selection once, left-drag to pan, right-click to confirm a polygon
terrainEditor.polygonHint: Click on the canvas to add vertices, then right-click or press "Complete Polygon" to close it. Then adjust the feather width and press "Confirm" to add to the selection (3 or more required)
terrainEditor.autoHint: If a selection exists, erosion starts from it (raindrop count is auto-scaled to the selected area); otherwise it applies to the entire map. The editor may freeze for a few seconds while running
terrainEditor.seaFloorNoTarget: No cells qualified as sea. Adjust the sea threshold elevation
terrainEditor.seaFloorHint: Cells at or below the threshold elevation are treated as sea and deepened with the given slope away from the coastline (smoothly approaching the max depth). Intended for data where the sea is uniformly 0m (e.g. GSI DEM). If there are 0m areas you want to keep (such as lakes), select only the sea area first before running
terrainEditor.resizeGridError: 2xcell_size is not divisible by near spacing
terrainEditor.waterHint: In add-water mode, left-click to add water polygon vertices, right-click (or "Close Shape") to close the shape (3+ points). Left-drag to pan. After closing the shape, set the water level below and press "Confirm Water" to register it as one water body. The sea (elevation 0m) is represented automatically; here you add only non-sea water bodies such as lakes.
terrainEditor.waterShapeClosed: Shape closed. Set the water level and press "Confirm Water".
terrainEditor.resourceHint: While the Resources tab is active, the editor is in resource-drawing mode: left-click to add polygon vertices, right-click (or "Close Shape") to close the shape (3+ points). Left-drag pans the view. After closing the shape, set the type, maximum deposit, and recovery rate, then press "Confirm Resource" to register it as one resource area. Registered resources are placed when a new city is started on this map.
terrainEditor.resourceMasterUnavailable: Resource types cannot be selected because master data is unavailable (backend not running?). Existing resources can still be viewed and deleted.
terrainEditor.resourceRecoveryHint: A recovery rate of 0 makes a non-renewable resource (ore vein, oil field, etc.) that depletes as it is extracted.
terrainEditor.resourceShapeClosed: Shape closed. Set the type and deposit, then press "Confirm Resource".
terrainEditor.resourceTypeRequired: Select a resource type to confirm.
terrainEditor.rainAreaHint: If a selection exists, rain falls only within it (rivers originating there flow all the way to the sea). Without a selection, rain falls on the whole map. Draw the area with the same tools as the Terrain tab (left-click for brush/polygon selection, right-click to close a polygon).
terrainEditor.riverHint: Automatically traces river courses from the terrain. "Compute Courses" does not modify the terrain. If there are too many or too few rivers, adjust the rainfall or minimum discharge and recompute.
terrainEditor.riverComputeHint: Computed courses are added to the list below as "not carved" (the terrain is not modified yet). Delete unwanted rivers or adjust each river's depth coefficient in the list, then carve them into the terrain one by one with "Carve". Recomputing replaces only the uncarved rivers.
terrainEditor.riverZeroHint: The maximum discharge on this map is {{maxQ}} m³/s, below the minimum discharge of {{minQ}} m³/s. Lower the minimum discharge or increase the rainfall.
terrainEditor.riverZeroShortHint: Some stretches exceed the minimum discharge, but they were too short to form rivers ({{discarded}} discarded). Lowering the minimum discharge further extends the channels upstream so they can qualify.
terrainEditor.riverDeleteHint: Deleting removes only the river data (water surface / saved data); the carved terrain is not restored. Use Ctrl+Z to restore the terrain as well.

god_edit.deleteConfirm: Really delete this entity? This cannot be undone.
